title: Multiplicativity of Walsh characters on disjoint sets
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $S, T \subseteq [n]$ be disjoint subsets of coordinates. Then for every point $x$ of the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$, the Walsh--Fourier character of the union factors as the product of the characters of the two sets:
\[
  \chi_{S \cup T}(x) \;=\; \chi_S(x)\,\chi_T(x).
\]
hypotheses_covered: S and T are subsets of the coordinate set [n]
x is a point of the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
replaced: If $S$ and $T$ are disjoint then $\chi_{S\cup T}(x) = \chi_S(x)\cdot\chi_T(x)$.
